name: Chicken Hawaiian
recipeIngredient: 1 can (14 oz/398 mL) pineapple tidbits with juice

recipeInstructions.text: Combine rice, chicken broth, and contents of Bake 'N Shake pouch as directed on the package.
Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in a 9x13 inch (2.5 L) casserole dish.
Coat chicken with a mixture of ground ginger and garlic.
Top chicken with pineapple tidbits and juice.
Sprinkle the prepared rice mixture over the chicken.
Bake uncovered at 375°F (180°C) for 30 minutes.

keywords: Hawaiian chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken and rice

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple with Chicken and Ginger
_similar.description: A classic sweet and sour dish featuring parboiled chicken legs in a tangy pineapple and ginger sauce, served over fried rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and separate chicken legs at the joint. Parboil for 15 to 20 minutes to remove excess fat.
Saute onions and celery in vegetable oil until tender. Add drained mushrooms and cook briefly.
Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in hot water. Add soya sauce, ginger, salt, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch with cold water until smooth. Pour into boiling sauce and stir frequently until thickened.
Add drained pineapple to the sauce. Adjust seasoning with pineapple juice if desired.
Lay parboiled chicken pieces in a greased casserole dish. Pour sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve over Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, ginger sauce

_similar.name: Sticky Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish baked in a sticky sauce with pineapple and mushrooms.

recipeInstructions.text: Shake chicken pieces in a bag with flour, paprika, ginger, and garlic powder to coat.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, soya sauce, and drained mushrooms. Mix well.
Place the coated chicken in a pan, skin side down. Pour the sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F, uncovered, for 1 hour. Baste often and turn the chicken at 30 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, add drained pineapple tidbits and an additional can of drained mushrooms.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken, baked chicken, pineapple chicken

_similar.name: Curry Chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix all ingredients except chicken breasts in a microwave-safe bowl until butter is melted.
Arrange chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray.
Pour the curry mixture over the chicken breasts.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

_similar.keywords: curry chicken, baked chicken, honey mustard chicken

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken

_similar.name: Favourite Chicken
_similar.description: A simple and satisfying chicken dish baked with cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, and garlic.
recipeIngredient: 1 can cheddar cheese soup (or other soup to taste)

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and pat dry chicken breasts.
Combine cheddar cheese soup, mushroom soup, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Place chicken in a 9x11 inch baking dish. Pour soup mixture over chicken.
Top with grated cheese and sliced mushrooms.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour for 4 pieces or 1½ hours for 6 pieces.
Check to ensure chicken is cooked through, as oven temperatures may vary.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, cheddar cheese, mushroom soup, comfort food
